receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster to independently owned 256x129 bicubic output at the same sample depth. Complete public Resize, admission, allocation/materialization/disposal. FFmpeg zscale's zimg backend with B=0/C=0.5, encoded-space premultiplied filtering. TIMED complete packed-source deinterleaving, four-pixel clamped halo (4.697% input-area increase), filtering, independent planar/packed output allocation, repacking and release. Graph/input-workspace/scratch contexts reused; every call processes every selected sample. Managed exact rational pixels; explicitly approved native-only RGB/alpha maximum1/RMSE0.25; normal/scalar bounded difference; zero-alpha RGBzero. This is the labeled scaler backend, not FFmpeg CLI.
